chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said:

Regarding a mukatabah whose master has intercourse with her and she becomes pregnant, he said: "He must pay to her the equivalent dowry of her like, and she must strive regarding her value; if she is unable, then she is among the mothers of children (umm al-walad)."

key_terms.أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ: slave-women who bore children to their masters and have a distinct legal status
key_terms.مَهْرَ مِثْلِهَا: the equivalent dowry customarily due to one like her
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَةٍ: a female slave under a manumission contract

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a mukatabah slave-woman who becomes pregnant by her master?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a mukatabah female slave who becomes pregnant by her master. It establishes financial liability upon the master and clarifies her resulting legal status if she cannot fulfill the remaining value of her contract. The report is significant for Shia fiqh discussions on emancipation, liability, and the status of umm al-walad.
